title: 1996 fzj80 LS1 swap completed
ai_summary: Despite the thread title referencing LS1, the builder's own signature clarifies the completed swap in this 1996 FZJ80 (LX450 variant) actually used a 6.2L LS-family engine paired to a 6L90E automatic, with the stock Toyota transfer case and 4WD wiring left functionally unchanged. Dirty Dingo LS street rod motor mounts were used. No dyno numbers were posted, but a test rider described the truck as driving 'smooth as glass' with strong power.

complications.detail: Builder said he'd prefer drive-by-cable over drive-by-wire on a future build to avoid a module failure stranding the truck on trail
Used Dirty Dingo LS street rod motor mounts for engine placement
